### **1. `modeling_ctrl.py`**
This file implements a **custom transformer model** called `CTRLModel`, based on the original [Salesforce/ctrl](https://huggingface.co/salesforce/ctrl) architecture. It introduces **control codes** as input tokens for a text-to-image generation model.

#### Key Components:
- **`angle_defn` & `positional_encoding`**: Standard sinusoidal positional encodings.
- **`eager_attention_forward`**: Custom attention implementation (copied from BERT) that handles attention masks and dropout.
- **`MultiHeadAttention`**: Standard multi-head self-attention with causal masking support.
- **`EncoderLayer`**: A single transformer block with attention and feed-forward networks.
- **`CTRLPreTrainedModel` & `CTRLModel`**: 
  - `CTRLModel`: The main transformer architecture.
  - Uses **positional encoding as a `nn.Buffer`** (not a parameter) so it can be moved to device/dtype at runtime.
  - Inputs: `input_ids`, `past_key_values`, `attention_mask`, etc.
  - Outputs: `last_hidden_state`, `past_key_values`.
